summary_text: In April 2026, the user purchased fresh, unbranded vegetables on three independent dates (2026-04-10, 2026-04-16, 2026-04-23). While the specific daypart varied (evening on 04-10, morning on 04-16 and 04-23), the morning purchase pattern is supported by two independent dates. No specific brand or variant preferences are established as all items are unbranded.
